standard_prerequisites.name: Vanishing of the higher direct images of an affine morphism, and the Leray spectral sequence
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter spaces-cohomology.tex, label lemma-affine-vanishing-higher-direct-images (invoked at proof line 3053) and Cohomology on Sites, label sites-cohomology-lemma-Leray (invoked at proof line 3054)
standard_prerequisites.use: They transport the vanishing of $H^1$ from the base to any space affine over it, which is part (1).

standard_prerequisites.name: Affineness is preserved by base change, and morphisms of affine schemes are affine
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Morphisms of Spaces, label spaces-morphisms-lemma-base-change-affine (invoked at proof line 3057)
standard_prerequisites.use: Applied to the structure morphism $X \to \Spec(A)$ and the affine base change $\Spec(A') \to \Spec(A)$, it shows that $X' \to X$ is affine.

standard_prerequisites.name: The pushforward of the structure sheaf along an affine base change
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter spaces-cohomology.tex, label lemma-affine-base-change (invoked at proof line 3062)
standard_prerequisites.use: It computes $(X' \to X)_*\mathcal{O}_{X'} = A' \otimes_A \mathcal{O}_X$, which turns the global sections computation into a tensor product over $A$.

standard_prerequisites.name: Global sections of the pullback of a module in the vanishing situation
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter spaces-cohomology.tex, label lemma-vanishing-compute (invoked at proof line 3067)
standard_prerequisites.use: It gives $\Gamma(X, A' \otimes_A \mathcal{O}_X) = A'$, completing the second assertion.

core_obligations: Prove part (1) by applying the vanishing of higher direct images for an affine morphism together with the Leray spectral sequence (proof lines 3052-3054).
For part (2), note that $X' \to X$ is affine as a base change of the affine structure morphism $X \to \Spec(A)$ along the affine morphism $\Spec(A') \to \Spec(A)$ (proof lines 3055-3059).

Identify the pushforward of the structure sheaf as $A' \otimes_A \mathcal{O}_X$ and compute the global sections through the known computation of global sections of such a pullback, obtaining $\Gamma(X', \mathcal{O}_{X'}) = A'$ (proof lines 3059-3068).
proof_roadmap: Part (1) from affine vanishing and Leray (proof lines 3052-3054).
Affineness of the base changed morphism (proof lines 3055-3059).
The pushforward of the structure sheaf and its global sections (proof lines 3059-3068).
difficulty_reason: The lemma records that the vanishing situation is stable under affine base change: the first cohomology of every quasi-coherent module vanishes on a space affine over the ambient one, and for a base change of the base ring the morphism stays affine with the expected global sections (statement lines 3040-3050). The proof transports the vanishing through the Leray spectral sequence, and identifies the pushforward of the structure sheaf with the tensor product whose global sections were computed previously. The transport of the two statements along the base change is the substance, so the claim is H2.
